question: Compare the performance of our two biggest categories and explain the difference
sql:
SELECT
  p.category,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price), 2) AS net_revenue,
  COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orders,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(oi.sale_price), COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id)), 2) AS aov,
  ROUND(AVG(p.retail_price), 2) AS avg_list_price
FROM s_order_items AS oi
JOIN s_orders   AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN s_products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10
report: Revenue alongside average order value and list price, because two categories can reach the same revenue through very different routes: many cheap orders or few expensive ones. The pricing column is what separates the two explanations.
